text:
Eli Navarro: opened PR to merge the pricing tiers + quota guide and update all code examples to the v2 SDK. also included a new 'quick math' worked example for cross-tier billing. https://github.com/redwoodinference/docs/pull/921
Haruka Tan: nice. can you add an explicit numeric example for reserved + burst vs payg? support keeps asking for a 'who pays what' line.
Eli Navarro: yes, thinking 3-step: reserved consumes first X, burst covers up to Y, remainder billed at payg. short table and one inline example.
Imani Brooks: quick heads up on snippets: v2 expects header X-RW-Metering-Context (some files still use X-Metering). also prefer the fluent call `client.withQuota({tier: '...'})` instead of manual headers in the sample.
Eli Navarro: thanks  I'll replace the header occurrences and swap to .withQuota().
build-bot: docs-lint: found 2 deprecated headers in examples/pricing.md line 33 and examples/snippets/tiers.md line 12.
Haruka Tan: on the dashboard PNG — the image shows metric name metering.tier_requests while the example query uses metering.requests_by_tier_total. please make them identical so folks can copy the query.
Eli Navarro: will re-export the panel and update the Grafana query.
Imani Brooks: small migration note for self-hosted agents: older agents (<=v3.1) still inject X-Metering. Suggest a one-line note: "Self-hosted agents older than v3.2 continue to emit X-Metering; upgrade to use X-RW-Metering-Context." keep it short and link agent changelog.
Eli Navarro: added a short migration bullet under "Deployments" and linked the agent release notes.
docs-bot: PR 921 updated by eli  replaced headers and added migration bullet. snippet-check failed (missing mock fixture).
Imani Brooks: I'll push a tiny offline test fixture that instantiates a mocked v2 client and asserts header presence and .withQuota() usage. no network required.
Haruka Tan: also add a parenthetical about embeddings billing (charged per vector unit, not per token) — one-liner with link to embeddings billing. small but prevents confusion.
Imani Brooks: pushed fixture to the branch -> https://github.com/redwoodinference/docs/pull/921/files#diff-7b.
build-bot: snippet-check: pass after Imani's fixture. preview: https://deploy-preview-921--docs.redwood.ai/pricing/tiers-quota
Eli Navarro: preview looks good. fixed the PNG and query mismatch. formatting nit: use single backticks for inline flags and fenced blocks for full code to satisfy the linter.
Haruka Tan: LGTM. once Netlify completes, please ping #support with a one-line heads-up about the header rename so they can update canned responses.
Eli Navarro: will do. merging after deploy preview finishes. follow-ups: add runbook mapping old->new metric names and add the snippet fixture to the docs test suite. :rocket:
